title: Special Intensive Revision (SIR) — Telangana
purpose: Remove deceased, permanently shifted, duplicate or ineligible entries
Ensure no eligible citizen is left out
Correct errors and register new voters
fieldProcess: Door-to-door verification by Booth Level Officers (BLOs)
Pre-filled Enumeration Forms issued in duplicate to existing voters
Minimum three visit attempts if household is locked
2002 electoral roll used as historical reference for family linkage
Online form download/submission allowed; BLO physical verification still required
Supporting documents generally collected during claims & objections, not initial enumeration

schedule.detail: Area mapping, BLO training, form printing
BLO visits; distribute and collect enumeration forms
